session_summary: Tested Frostfang Pass (Difficulty 3) as the Combat Challenger. Encountered only 2 enemies (a Slime and a Kobold) across 12 steps, with the remaining actions dominated by linear walking and simple obstacle jumps. Completed the route with full 100 HP, indicating very low combat friction or threat.

observations.evidence: In a Difficulty 3 route (Frostfang Pass), only 2 enemy encounters (Slime at step 2 and Kobold at step 11) occurred over 12 total steps.
observations.recommendation: Increase enemy spawn density and introduce mid-route elite encounters on difficulty 3+ routes to match the expected challenge level.

observations.evidence: Finished Frostfang Pass with 100/100 HP intact and +25 coins, completing the route without taking any damage or facing tactical pressure.
observations.recommendation: Adjust enemy attack patterns and introduce aggressive hazard-enemy synergies on high-tier routes to ensure risk aligns with reward.

feature_requests.title: Elite Enemy Waves & Aggressive Encounter Pacing on Difficulty 3+ Routes
feature_requests.player_value: Provides high-tier combat challengers with meaningful tactical friction, tight resource management, and a sense of mastery.
feature_requests.rationale: Current high-difficulty routes feature sparse enemy spacing, making combat feel trivial rather than challenging.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add elite enemy variants and increased encounter frequency to routes with difficulty 3 or higher.

keep: Clean telemetry event logging for enemy defeats and obstacle jumps.
Responsive route completion rewards and clear step transitions.
focus: encounter pacing, enemy friction, risk/reward, challenge and mastery
